Both clients exit normally with full health, empty cursor, stopped navigation, unchanged frozen production bytes and no class-origin violation.

The source adds bounded observation only. These passes do not prove a behavior repair, intermittent-failure reliability, natural gameplay, full parity or user acceptance.
The earlier modern failure and earlier primary verifier assertion failure remain separate evidence for their named artifacts.
Exact primary, modern and legacy local builds pass. CI is recorded at its exact source head and may still be running; incomplete jobs do not establish compile support.

Two original gameplay captures pass anonymous byte/hash read-back and signed-out 640x360 decode. Four exact local original/staging PNG copies are removed. Worlds, logs, receipts and frozen artifacts remain.
